evidence_boundary: Coverage design. Individual evidence reports establish outcomes; a mapping is not a passed criterion.

requirements.title: One authorized intake route
acceptance_criteria: Equivalent prompt, file, and skill inputs retain the same objective, deliverables, acceptance criteria, constraints, source references, project root, and action-authority boundary.
An upstream handoff retains any supplied document or plan ID and its inspected revision or digest. Merely opening or approving a document does not start execution.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Task input/lifecycle contract; source/root selection fixtures
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Equivalent input packets and source-bound manager bootstrap

requirements.title: Launch a real task manager
acceptance_criteria: A native runtime receipt identifies the manager as an agent instance distinct from the calling host; relabeling the host does not satisfy the requirement.

The calling host relays user input and results after handoff without concurrently performing the same manager responsibilities. Repeated intake for the same live execution does not create a competing manager.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Manager reservation, duplicate/reconnect, writer/generation rejection
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Distinct host/manager launch and actual reconnect receipt

requirements.title: Retain Director and systems-engineering responsibilities
acceptance_criteria: Before decomposition, its inspectable context identifies the owning project, relevant architecture and interfaces, state ownership, dependencies, constraints, protected behavior, change impact, risks, and verification needs.

The applicable local guidance and relevant project artifacts support that context. The manager retains scope, role selection, coordination, acceptance, integration, and final verification responsibility.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Director and manager role contracts; complete baseline validation
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Manager context and bounded mixed-category decomposition

requirements.title: Decompose into bounded coordinated subtasks
acceptance_criteria: Each executable subtask identifies its objective, requirement links, inputs, dependencies, deliverable, accountable assignment, allowed reads and writes, protected scope, acceptance criteria, and stopping condition.
Missing dependency targets and dependency cycles prevent dependent execution. A small objective may use one generic subtask; mixed-category tasks retain main-task integration checks.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Missing/cyclic dependencies, baseline/slot completeness, verification gates
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Generic-to-complex-to-extra dependency chain and main integration

requirements.title: Classify every executable subtask
acceptance_criteria: No runnable subtask is uncategorized or substitutes `direct`, `decomposed`, or `adversarial` for the required category. Decomposition and category selection remain separate decisions.

Reclassification records the changed evidence and applicable gates. It cannot silently bypass failed review, reduce a required team because of capacity, or split an inseparable decision solely to evade review.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Three-category matrix; team counts; reclassification negative controls
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Mixed categories retained under actual capacity

requirements.title: Execute generic work with one worker
acceptance_criteria: One worker returns its deliverables, actual changes, proportionate checks, evidence, and limitations to the manager. The category adds no solver panel, reviewer agent, senior synthesizer, or separate implementation child.
Targeted corrections return to the responsible worker. Replacement after failure records revocation of the previous ownership before assigning a replacement; the manager directly verifies the result.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Generic delivered result, exclusive scope and replacement gates
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Exactly one generic execution worker and direct manager verification

requirements.title: Develop independent solutions for multi-solution work
acceptance_criteria: All planned solvers receive the same versioned problem baseline and success criteria, with documented role differences. Two is a minimum, not a fixed required team size.

Initial candidate development excludes sibling drafts, including for queued solvers. Separate candidate artifacts identify each contribution; competing solvers do not implement conflicting production changes in the shared worktree.
A missing required candidate blocks collection. A runtime that cannot preserve the required independence reports the limitation instead of claiming independent development.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Frozen slot completeness, common packet and queued candidate gates
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Three independent complete-problem solvers with queued third launch

requirements.title: Assign a distinct senior synthesizer
acceptance_criteria: The senior is a distinct runtime instance from the manager and solvers; for extra-complex work it is also distinct from the assigned reviewers.

The senior receives every required current candidate, relevant evidence, limitations, and applicable review findings. Complex work has no mandatory per-candidate reviewer stage; extra-complex eligibility follows REQ-014.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Native identity uniqueness and exact senior input packet
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Distinct senior with every current candidate and applicable findings

requirements.title: Fuse compatible contributions into a coherent solution
acceptance_criteria: The proposal identifies its current source candidates, retained contributions, justified omissions, resolved differences, assumptions, interfaces, requirement coverage, residual risks, and verification approach.
The result contains no unresolved mutually exclusive core commitments. Concatenation, majority vote, an unexplained preferred candidate, or an unsupported endorsement does not satisfy fusion.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Synthesis dispositions and unresolved-core rejection
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Senior coherent proposal with retained/omitted contributions and five difference classes

requirements.title: Return unresolved opposition with a shared explanation
acceptance_criteria: The conflict identifies the synthesis round, common problem baseline, candidate versions, incompatible claims, affected requirements, supporting evidence, and required resolution.
All solver assignments receive the same shared explanation; any role-specific action notes are separate. An opposing core commitment is not discarded merely to declare a winner.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Shared conflict artifact/recipient digest and current round gates
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Same conflict sent to every originating extra-complex solver

requirements.title: Repeat solution and synthesis cycles with current evidence
acceptance_criteria: Affected originating solvers return materially revised candidates or resolving evidence. An unaffected solver may return a versioned revalidation explaining compatibility.

The next synthesis uses a consistent current candidate set and problem baseline. Repeated unchanged failure or exhausted authorized resources produces an honest non-complete state, never forced acceptance.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Conflict round invalidation and revised/revalidated candidate guards
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Same solvers revise after shared explanation with actual follow-up

requirements.title: Assign one distinct reviewer to every extra-complex solver
acceptance_criteria: The solver-to-reviewer mapping is one-to-one. Self-review and a single reviewer instance shared among solvers are rejected.

Reviewer role definitions may be reused when suitable, while reviewer runtime instances remain distinct. The assigned reviewer evaluates its own solver's current candidate against the common criteria.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: One-to-one slots, self/native-ID substitution rejection
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Two distinct assigned reviewer instances

requirements.title: Revise rejected candidates through their reviewers
acceptance_criteria: A rejection identifies failed criteria, evidence, and required changes, distinguishing mandatory defects from optional improvements.
The originating solver returns a new candidate version and a response to findings. A rejected candidate cannot become passed through a manager override or without current review of the revision.
The same reviewer assignment continues while its runtime session remains available; any necessary replacement preserves the mapping and review history.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Rejected candidate supersession and current review fixture
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Controlled initial rejection, same-solver correction and same-reviewer pass

requirements.title: Require all current review passes before extra-complex synthesis
acceptance_criteria: Any missing, rejected, blocked, or stale review prevents synthesis. A pass on an earlier version does not admit a changed candidate.
The synthesis input set corresponds exactly to the eligible reviewed versions.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Missing/rejected/stale review and changed findings rejection
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Actual failed senior attempt before complete current reviews

requirements.title: Reapply review after extra-complex synthesis conflicts
acceptance_criteria: The shared conflict reaches all solvers; revised or revalidated current candidates receive their associated reviewers' current attestations under the updated context.
No conflict revision bypasses REQ-014 or retains a pass invalidated by a material baseline change.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Conflict delivery and all-current re-review gates
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Both solver revisions return through their own reviewers before senior follow-up

requirements.title: Return synthesis to the manager for acceptance
acceptance_criteria: The manager records acceptance of the exact current proposal, requests a bounded correction, or records a specific blocker.
The senior cannot authorize implementation, change the user's scope, or close the Task. There is no additional senior layer implied by wording in the source handoff.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Manager-only acceptance with exact synthesis binding
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Senior returns actual proposal; manager records inspected acceptance

requirements.title: Use one dedicated implementation child when required
acceptance_criteria: The implementation instance is distinct from the manager, solvers, reviewers, and senior, with one active owner for the accepted solution and an exact scope, protected state, checks, evidence, and stopping condition.
An analysis or recommendation objective that is already satisfied by the accepted deliverable creates no unnecessary implementation child; a coding objective is not complete on a design alone.

A material design defect returns to the manager for a bounded decision or reopened solution cycle. The implementer does not silently replace the accepted design; changed acceptance binds to the revised solution.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Reserved acceptance/input packet and result-target binding; coding/analysis outcomes
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Dedicated distinct coding implementer; complex analysis-only outcome

requirements.title: Persist project-local roles and an accurate index
acceptance_criteria: The index resolves to current valid role bundles and exposes relevant invalid-role diagnostics. A missing, stale, or misleading entry cannot make a missing or invalid bundle eligible.

The existing paired-file format, valid role metadata and links, safe names, path confinement, and overwrite protections remain supported. New installations discover active roles under `roles/`, with any legacy lookup limited to explicit transition or diagnostics.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: 57 role catalog behavior cases; source/installed pair and metadata checks
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Selected persisted active pairs and actual child role reads

requirements.title: Select a suitable existing role before creating one
acceptance_criteria: Manager, generic worker, solver, reviewer, senior, and implementer selection records identify the objective, domain capabilities, reads and writes, deliverable, tools and skills, authority, risk, stopping condition, selected role, both file paths, inspected revision or digests, and fit rationale.

Role content is read and applied by the assigned agent. An unsuitable or invalid role is not accepted solely because it exists; a tool, permission, dependency, or runtime gap is reported separately from a role gap.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Fresh catalog/digest and separate fit capability fields; invalid role rejection
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Separate manager/worker/solver/reviewer/senior/implementer fit records

requirements.title: Create and persist roles for demonstrated gaps
acceptance_criteria: Fresh inventory and fit evidence precede creation. The new paired-file bundle validates, appears accurately in the index, and is available for later tasks before an agent uses it.

Creation preserves unrelated files and reusable-source ownership. It does not invent unavailable capabilities, duplicate a suitable role, or treat a missing tool or permission as a role-definition gap.
A partial publication identifies the committed bundle and remaining index recovery without duplicate creation or deletion of valid work.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Deterministic/forged/stale index, collision and partial-publication tests
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Live root and delivered starter catalog/index read-only validation

requirements.title: Preserve exact model and reasoning identity
acceptance_criteria: Runtime-provided evidence or a named verified runtime inheritance guarantee establishes parity for each assignment. Prompt assertions and unverified aliases alone are insufficient.
The workflow distinguishes direct observed identity matches, verified inheritance-contract evidence, and unverified settings. Known mismatches or insufficient guarantees prevent compliant dispatch.

Model identity and context provision are checked separately. A user-requested mid-run model or reasoning change reconciles the active team before further assignments under the new identity; no automatic downgrade or user-configuration rewrite supplies an exception.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Settings equality/mismatch and effective inheritance contract
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Exact full-history inheritance receipts for every actual native assignment

requirements.title: Adapt to the owning project
acceptance_criteria: Common orchestration does not hard-code a product domain or copy depot-only registration authority into ordinary product Directors.

A clean temporary project created from the designated Template receives usable current starter contracts and roles without copied live Task history, coordinator assignments, native agent IDs, or execution state.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Source project-neutral scope checks; initializer create/prepare/repeat fixtures
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Fresh disposable initialized project with no inherited live state

requirements.title: Maintain one manager and one canonical writer
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate intake, stale manager results, competing writers, and replacement attempts cannot create competing accepted ownership or duplicate work. Live matching execution identity is checked before reconnection.

The host's bootstrap write authority ends at handoff. Ordinary workers, reviewers, and seniors do not mutate canonical Task state, final Task Responses, or role indexes or promote themselves to manager by reading root guidance.

Replacement reconciles outstanding agents and explicitly revokes the previous assignment. A claimed actor field or role prose is not described as operating-system authentication or filesystem isolation.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Single writer, duplicate manager, result producer and manager recovery guards
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Activated manager sole canonical writer and host steering relay

requirements.title: Keep orchestration identities and provenance distinct
acceptance_criteria: Each accepted artifact or result resolves to its Task, subtask, responsible runtime instance, selected role revision, input baseline, and artifact version or digest as applicable.
Actual native IDs originate in tool receipts. Role names, subtask IDs, conversation IDs, placeholders, or child success text cannot substitute for runtime identity or completed work.
Duplicate, stale, or out-of-order results are identifiable and cannot repeat an already accepted transition; historical results retain their attribution.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Typed cross-reference validation, replay and stale-event rejection
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Actual role/native/slot/artifact identities in canonical native records

requirements.title: Bind reviews and acceptance to exact current versions
acceptance_criteria: A change to candidate bytes invalidates a dependent pass even if its filename and title remain unchanged.
A material input, requirement, or problem-baseline change invalidates dependent review or acceptance until current evidence establishes eligibility again; stale records remain history.
A synthesis uses a mutually consistent current candidate set, and implementation identifies the exact manager-accepted current solution.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Candidate/review/synthesis/acceptance/input hash, round and dependency invalidation
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Current versions through rejection, shared conflict and implementation

requirements.title: Distinguish reconcilable differences from contradictions
acceptance_criteria: Complementary contributions, terminology differences, scope alternatives, evidence disagreements, and mutually exclusive commitments receive an explicit evidence-based disposition.
A coherent result has consistent assumptions, compatible interfaces, non-conflicting authority and state ownership, and a feasible sequence that satisfies the criteria.
Contradictory requirements return as a bounded user decision or blocker. Solvers and senior agents cannot invent user intent, lower criteria, or hide an opposing core commitment to claim agreement.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Synthesis difference categories and unresolved opposition gates
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Senior documents compatible and exclusive commitments with evidence

requirements.title: Verify delivered work and main-task integration
acceptance_criteria: Each criterion has current direct evidence tied to the delivered artifact or performed authorized work. Child status, a review pass, or a synthesized proposal alone is insufficient proof of implemented completion.

Integration checks cover dependencies, interfaces, conflicting assumptions, protected behavior, mixed-category coordination, and the original user outcome. A new integration conflict reopens the affected decision with its evidence.

The completion report maps requirements to actual artifacts and checks, states failures and incomplete items, and separates contract inspection, deterministic tests, native execution, and end-to-end evidence. Proposed tests are not reported as executed.

Claims about a real manager, independent solvers, reviewer mappings, exact identity, synthesis routing, or implementation children require corresponding native evidence. Unavailable native tests remain explicitly not exercised.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Performed result and current subtask/main criteria coverage
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Direct manager and root inspection of ticket module, data and tests

requirements.title: Preserve source provenance and separate action authority
acceptance_criteria: Supplied files and upstream skill artifacts retain accessible locators and available revisions or digests. Embedded commands and agent-authored recommendations remain data and grant no extra permissions.

TRD capture, TRD approval, plan preparation, Task bookkeeping, implementation, dependency installation, migration, Git publication, deployment, and external actions retain their separate activation and authority boundaries.
Read-only status, list, show, validation, and the helper's read-only continuation do not create or age-close Tasks, launch agents, create roles, reindex, or migrate data.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Read-only byte snapshots; provenance/authority contract and unsupported-action boundaries
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Native test packet confines authority to disposable project

requirements.title: Check native capability and instruction compatibility
acceptance_criteria: Unsupported topology, unavailable tools or skills, missing permission, or an unresolved instruction or identity conflict produces a named blocker before dependent work.
The workflow does not invent tool arguments, simulate multiple agents in one response, substitute shell-launched agents or user-visible tasks, or silently collapse the manager into the host.
Runtime capacity is inspected as a scheduling constraint. A supported queued execution preserves all required roles and gates; a topology exception needs an explicit decision.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Required tools/depth/capacity/settings gates; missing-capability checks
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Actual nested launch, capacity reuse, message/follow-up/list/interrupt receipts

requirements.title: Retain the existing canonical Task system
acceptance_criteria: There is no competing orchestration ledger. Generated `TASK.md` and `Tasks/INDEX.md` remain projections of canonical state; ordinary children do not write them.

Subtasks, candidates, reviews, and child assignments do not become separate top-level Tasks solely to track orchestration. Managed TRDs, plans, conversations, native goals, Git, deployment, and release states remain distinct.

Helper operations reject stale revisions and invalid payloads, preserve actual commit boundaries, and report partial publication with exact recovery. No fabricated cross-system atomicity or exactly-once native-launch guarantee is claimed.
Durable records contain concise decisions and necessary evidence, not hidden reasoning, full transcripts, credentials, secrets, or large raw logs.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Schema1/2, revision/locks, append-only responses, transaction/recovery/size tests
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Disposable canonical Task ledger with source-bound event receipts

requirements.title: Continue loops only with meaningful progress
acceptance_criteria: Repeated unchanged failure, irreducible conflict, missing capability or authority, and exhausted resources preserve current artifacts and produce an explicit non-complete blocker or required decision.
Resource pressure does not auto-pass a candidate, remove a required solver or reviewer, lower acceptance criteria, or change model or reasoning settings.
Optional improvements do not extend review indefinitely after mandatory criteria are met.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Block/stop state and meaningful-progress instruction controls
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Controlled targeted correction/conflict; exact non-complete recovery states

requirements.title: Respect runtime capacity and write ownership
acceptance_criteria: No two active assignments own the same accepted solution implementation or overlapping write scope. Solver candidates have distinct protected artifact ownership.

Queued execution retains the required logical agent instances, role distinctions, candidate independence, review gates, and exact identity. No fixed concurrency number or simultaneous full-team launch is required.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Write overlap, duplicate owner, frozen team and capacity rejection
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Queued solvers and distinct private writes with one implementation owner

requirements.title: Preserve existing roles and Task history during transition
acceptance_criteria: Existing valid roles remain recoverable and attributable after transition, with unchanged content retained where semantics are unchanged. Historical path references and completed records are not rewritten to simulate new behavior.
Conflicting old and new role destinations are identified before overwrite. Read-only inspection does not migrate; any migration write requires explicit authority and exact reviewed scope.
Unsupported record versions or interrupted transitions fail safely with a documented recovery route. No old summary is used to invent live manager or child identities.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Selected upgrade original bytes; legacy transition collision/recovery/provenance tests
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Affirmative root/Template legacy and historical preservation inspection

requirements.title: Deliver to the confirmed Sys4AI destinations
acceptance_criteria: Reusable additions, modifications, and deletions originate in the appropriate `SKILLS-depo/`, `ROLES-depo/`, `AGENTS-depo/`, `SOULS-depo/`, or `SPECS-depo/` source collection as applicable. The explicit mappings and checked update workflow produce the designated Template.

The active root receives a separately reviewed local adoption that reconciles the changed manager, taxonomy, role path, state-writer, and implementation-owner contracts while preserving its depot responsibilities and unrelated edits.
Template mappings and initialization produce the new role layout and current common workflow in a temporary new project, with destination-appropriate role-index validation.

Each selected destination has relevant checks and preservation evidence. Registration does not authorize propagation into any other project; the registry remains factual and unselected project files remain untouched.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Updater/initializer and source/root specialization suites
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Checked Template publication, exact root adoption and fresh starter inspection

requirements.title: Account for outstanding agents when work stops or transfers
acceptance_criteria: New dispatch stops when the controlling action requires it; applicable interruption is requested, actual runtime status and known changes are reconciled, and any uncontained or unconfirmed worker is reported explicitly.
A stopped or cancelled execution is not labeled completed. An old timestamp or expired observation alone does not prove that a manager or worker has stopped.
Replacement does not duplicate a still-active owner. Native launch or receipt uncertainty is reconciled against the original assignment before retrying.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Unconfirmed stopping, old-generation rejection and replacement/settings controls
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Actual interruption/reconnect/replacement observations; unsupported live settings changes labeled

requirements.title: Preserve intentional intake and lifecycle policies
acceptance_criteria: Explicit work intake reuses a clearly matching active Task or creates one as the established root contract specifies. Completed history does not become a substitute for a new objective.
Read-only and unrelated requests do not run aging or create Tasks. Eligible age closure remains distinct from completion and preserves unfinished criteria and history.

Known active manager or unresolved write-owning worker state is reconciled before inactivity closure. No scheduled background process is added, and intentional source/template versus root intake differences remain documented.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Root automatic intake, historical new work, 30-day boundary and ownership guard fixtures
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Root read-only startup/status and history preservation; no live aging

requirements.title: Extend the existing helper architecture proportionately
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic storage and validation stay within the existing helper architecture; actual agent spawning and messaging use available native agent tools through the agent or skill workflow.

The change does not introduce a replacement general-purpose agent framework, database or queue service, mandatory memory or ontology backend, new model provider, or production dependency solely to implement orchestration.

Proposed module names, CLI operations, packet fields, and schema numbers are checked against the live implementation and documented through separately authorized planning; illustrative payloads are never treated as already-supported APIs.
requirements.deterministic_and_inspection: Standard-library imports, implemented CLI help/examples and layout checks
requirements.native_or_destination_observation: Native tools perform execution; helper only persists validated state
